newsitem.title: USA: Conseco on track for '97 oper shr $2.50-$2.75.
newsitem.headline: Conseco on track for '97 oper shr $2.50-$2.75.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Tuesday it is on track to meet or exceed analyst expectations of $2.50-$2.75 a share in operating earnings in 1997.

"Based on our internal growth opportunities, and factoring in the expected earnings from our December 1996 acquisitions ... as well as earnings from other acquisitions currently pending, we believe we are on track to equal or exceed analyst estimates of $2.50-$2.75 of operating earnings per share in 1997, an increase of at least 35 percent over 1996," chairman Stephen Hilbert said in a news release.

Hilbert said Conseco also intends to reduce its overhead expenses by at least $80 million in 1997 through the consolidation and streamlining of businesses it acquires and support a new cross-marketing effort designed to place its 150,000 agents into a single-minded distribution system.
Hilbert said he believes deregulation is making old distinctions between insurers and other financial services sectors more obsolete.
Conseco's three business segments include life insurance, annuities and supplemental health insuraance.
Its shares were trading down 5/8 Tuesday at 41-1/4.
